headline: At 5:02 PM a past-client couple wrote back on your own saved-search email: they are "very interested" in the Gallant Fox house AND "about ready to put ours on the market" — a two-sided at-bat, unprompted, on a Friday evening, and it landed inside the hour · DO: call the Stricklands tonight · WATCH: the lookalike meeting link, still do not open it.

notes: ✅ THE FLEET IS BACK ON ITS FEET — SIX ROUTINES HAVE RUN SINCE 2 PM after seventeen and a half hours of nothing. The milestone engine fired 195 Lake View UNDER_CONTRACT at 2:15, the console rebuilt at 2:30, the Delta ran two passes (2:40 and 3:25), the trading loop closed the week at 4:46, and the milestone engine swept again at 5:02 clean. The morning is still lost — no Daily, no Money Pulse, no marketing run, and zero ISA sweeps before 2 PM — but the afternoon is fully covered.

🛑 THE BRIVITY INSTANT-LEAD WEBHOOK IS STILL OFF, NINE HOURS AFTER IT DIED. Deactivated 9:32 AM after 243 errors in five minutes; nothing has opened the execution log and nothing has turned it back on. That webhook is the instant-responder's only input and the first rung of the ownership check — every lead arriving this evening lands in the CRM unseen. Five malformed alerts fired seconds before it died: debris, not leads. A p1 is on the CEO/Build board.

⚠️ NEW THIS RUN — LOOPNET NOW BLOCKS THE BOARD CRAWLER. Every commercial listing URL on Tyler's AllSouth board returned HTTP 403 this evening; the same fetches worked 7/29 and 7/30.
